# PixelLab Ltd.

> PixelLab Ltd. is a game studio in Dhaka, Bangladesh. It builds real-time multiplayer Bengali board games (16 Guti, Sholo Guti Pro) and Adda, a live streaming and social app, all running on its own real-time social multiplayer SDK.

## Products

- [16 Guti Game](https://pixellabltd.com/16-guti/): The classic Bengali strategy board game (16 beads, two sides). Play online against real opponents or offline against a bot. Android, 100K+ downloads, rated 4.7.
- [16 Guti: Sholo Guti Pro](https://pixellabltd.com/sholo-guti-pro/): Premium Sholo Guti with four game modes, VIP rooms and ranked play. Android, 100K+ downloads, rated 4.1.
- [Adda — Live Stream & Chat](https://pixellabltd.com/adda/): Social app to discover creators, go live and browse verified talent. Android, rated 12+.

## In development

These projects are planned or in development and not yet released:

- Ludo: Real-time online multiplayer Ludo, built on the same SDK as 16 Guti.
- Parchesi: Real-time online multiplayer Parchís / Parcheesi.
- Adda Live Gaming: Live social gaming rooms inside Adda, where people voice chat, hang out and play casual party games together in real time.
- Droid Harness: AI-driven Android automation tool that lets AI agents operate Android apps and devices for testing and repetitive tasks.

## Technology

PixelLab's in-house real-time social multiplayer SDK powers every board in 16 Guti and every live room in Adda:

- Server-authoritative game logic (every action validated on the server)
- Queue-based matchmaking into synced rooms
- Reconnect and resync mid-match
- Live streaming that holds up on weak connections

Stack: Colyseus, Socket.io, PlayFab, TypeScript, Railway, PostgreSQL, Firebase.
